name: merge-request-review
description: Ready GitLab MR review with discussion intake, applicable gates, CI-first evidence, bounded agents, focused re-review, and one clean-pass approval.
skillInstructions: Kimi Code compatibility: perform normal reviews locally by default and use built-in subagents only when the review risk and shared task budget justify them. GitLab reads, notes, and approval still require an external GitLab MCP.

interface.shortDescription: CI-first GitLab review with bounded agents and one clean pass
interface.longDescription: A Kimi Code GitLab merge request review workflow with current-discussion intake, canonical-source evidence, CI-first verification, focused delta re-review, and MCP-backed review state. External GitLab MCP access is still required.
